ns2:course.label: Language Literacy in Early Childhood Education I
ns2:course.description: Basic principles, techniques, and materials for the emergent literacy in infancy through preschool. Emphasizes linguistic and cultural factors in culturally diverse settings. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Admission to the Early Childhood Teacher Education Program. Concurrent enrollment in HDFS 301.
